description: US drought conditions (Drought Monitor) — Current US drought status for a point (lat/lon), county (5-digit FIPS), state (TX or 48) or the whole US from the weekly U.S. Drought Monitor: percent of area in D0-D4 (cumulative), predominant and worst category, DSCI severity index (0-500), status (NO DROUGHT / ABNORMALLY DRY / PARTLY IN DROUGHT / IN DROUGHT), trend vs 4 weeks ago and weekly history (weeks= 1-104).
